title: Advice to young players: learn everything
summary: Asked how young people should become jazz musicians, Armstrong says to be a good musician who can play symphony or blues.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: That is a long time. Yeah. If some young people would come to you and ask you, what shall we do? We would like to be jazz musicians. What is the best way?

Well, they couldn't ask that. Because I was taught just to be a good musician and you play everything. If you can jump from a symphony orchestra and go right down into some hole in the wall and play the blues, that's what you live for. That's what you learn instrument for.
